provider: AHN, the Dutch water authorities, provinces and Rijkswaterstaat
dataset: AHN5 classified-ground DTM 0.5 m, official AHN dataroom-linked WCS
acquisition_period: AHN5 2023–2025; service coverage snapshot labelled 2024-12-10. Exact local flight day is not asserted.
modern_banking_verification: At native3786.933m, AHN5 elevations at driver lanes−3/+3m are8.4319/6.4653m NAP, giving−18.14 degrees across6m. This independently confirms the post2019 rebuilt final banking. Existing native banking is preserved.
attribution: Bron: AHN (www.ahn.nl), AHN5 DTM, via the official dataroom-linked Ellipsis Drive WCS. Modified by bounded numeric export, centreline sampling, a documented tunnel-deck gap reconstruction, a 2 m noise filter and relative datum subtraction.
raster_band: Band1 is numeric F32 height. The returned second F32 band is constant1 coverage metadata, not another height observation. NaN is missing ground, never zero metres.
coordinate_registration: Invert the retained source origin and uniform scale for every native centreline sample, transform WGS84 to RD New, then bilinearly sample numeric band1 at pixel centres. No route translation, scale or banking change.
vertical_datum: Metres above the filtered road minimum, derived from NAP heights without a vertical multiplier.
interpolation: Circular Gaussian sigma2m, truncated at3sigma, removes source-pixel/IDW noise while retaining the broad T3 compression and Hunzerug climb. Maximum raw-height change0.162m; no grade clipping. Dense4m controls plus independent anchors retain the measured crest and trough. Periodic samples close the SF seam.

estimated_deck_gap.method: Linear chord only between the adjacent valid asphalt anchors across the13.52m DTM gap; subsequent2m filter joins grades. This is an estimated racing deck, not measured terrain under the tunnel.
estimated_deck_gap.source_feature: OSM way186321842, highway=service, layer−1, tunnel=yes, crosses the racing straight at52.38708N4.53959E. The DTM omits its road lid.
estimated_deck_gap.appearance_reference: Ignored reference final-875.00.jpg shows a continuous paved SF straight. This is visual context; the metric deck anchors come from AHN5.

uncertainty_note: The classified ground source is finer than the registered OSM raceway plan. The 2m horizontal and0.5m road-height allowances are reconstruction estimates, especially on steep bank transitions; no centimetre survey claim is made.
limitations: Source surface classification and OSM registration still need matched reference/runtime review. In particular the T3 bank is nonlinear across its width; a single native bank plane cannot reproduce every cross-section.
Existing registered banking controls, native road widths and protection are unchanged by this longitudinal correction.
Scenery NoData holes require separately labelled fills and mapped water masks; the road dataset alone does not establish the terrain beneath buildings or water.
